title: In JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA before 2026.3, 2026.2.4 code execution was possible in untrusted projects via the Code…
description: A high-severity vulnerability (CVE-2026-133254) exists in JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA versions before 2026.3 and 2026.2.4. This flaw allows code execution in untrusted projects via the Code Provenance plugin. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 8.3, indicating significant impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
